glm.feedback:
Findings:

- Category: test | Severity: low
  File: client/e2e/flows/wizard-plan-card-legibility.spec.ts:80 (description locator)
  Finding: `phase.locator("> div").nth(1)` relies on the phase row's second direct child being the description. If the row's child structure ever changes (a wrapper, an icon div), the test silently measures the wrong element's `color` — and since all siblings inherit the same color from the container, it would still pass or fail misleadingly. A `getByText`/role-based locator (or asserting the element's class/text) would be more robust.
  Suggestion: Locate the description via a stable attribute (e.g. a class or the text content) instead of positional child index, or add an assertion on the element's content before measuring.

- Category: test | Severity: low
  File: client/e2e/flows/wizard-plan-card-legibility.spec.ts:39-46 (contrastRatio)
  Finding: The RGB parser accepts `rgba(...)` but ignores the alpha channel. If the container background ever becomes translucent (or Chromium returns e.g. `color(srgb ...)` / `oklch(...)` under a different color space setting), the math is wrong or the helper throws — the throw is fine (fails loudly), but translucent backgrounds would be computed against black.
  Suggestion: Reject alpha < 1 explicitly, or fall back to a screenshot-based/`element.scrollWidth`-independent check. Low priority since the container background is opaque today.

- Category: spec | Severity: low
  File: .shipwright/planning/iterate/2026-09-19-...-miniplan.md / spec "Evidence" section
  Finding: AC-2 (the E2E contrast check) is marked mandatory, and the spec's Evidence section says "E2E — see result appended below once run", but the diff contains no appended E2E result. The spec file itself was added in this diff with the placeholder still unresolved, so the mandatory AC-2 pass is asserted but not evidenced.
  Suggestion: Append the actual Playwright run result to the spec before finalization, or note it was run and where the output lives.

Everything else checks out: the component change matches the spec exactly (className + testid added, redundant inline background/border/radius/shadow dropped, `maxWidth`/`padding` retained, first-row `borderTop` suppressed per the visual side-effect finding); the unit test is genuinely order-independent, reads the real whitelist from `on-photo.css` rather than hardcoding it (so a future whitelist edit fails loudly rather than silently passing), and the red→green probe was performed; the E2E spec correctly reads `color` from the description and `backgroundColor` from the container, avoiding the transparent-background trap the plan review flagged. No security surface, no API changes, no caller breakage (`phases.map` signature change adds an unused-in-output index only).

The change is sound, minimal, and matches the diagnosed mechanism; findings above are refinements.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: approve
